name: system_prompts_leaks
description: Extracted system prompts from Anthropic - Claude Fable 5.1, Opus 5, Claude Design, Claude Code. OpenAI - ChatGPT GPT-6-Astra, Codex. Google - Gemini 3.8 Flash, 3.1 Pro, Antigravity. xAI - Grok, Grok Bot, Cursor, Kimi and more! Updated regularly.
one_liner: A collection of the secret internal instructions that companies like Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google give their AI chatbots before you ever type a message.
buyer: No legitimate commercial buyer — this is a curiosity/research archive of material the AI companies did not intend to be public.
business_use_cases: None that hold up commercially — the content exists because it was extracted against the intent of the companies that wrote it.
A journalist or educator might reference it for an article explaining how AI chatbots are steered, but that's content, not a product.
Prompt engineers might study it for learning purposes, but reselling or productizing leaked material is not a sound foundation.

money_ideas.idea: None recommended — there's no ethical, durable revenue model built on redistributing leaked proprietary material.

steal_this: Not a business opportunity. Skip this one.
